title: ManagementResponse
description: Wrapper for the management-response artifact: acceptance posture, root cause, action plan with milestones and owners, interim mitigation, evidence-of-effectiveness plan, reporting cadence, and linkage to the underlying issue write-up. Consumed by risk-committee-pack (issues-and-remediation-status section) and the firm's response-file archive. Reuses issue.schema.json for finding linkage.

response_id.description: Stable ID for this response instance.

responding_institution.description: Legal entity name of the responding institution; legal-entity hierarchy where relevant.

scope_id.description: Links to scoping record if supplied.

addressee_name.description: e.g., the named regulator office, 'Audit Committee of the Board', 'Internal Audit', the external-assessor firm name.

finding_id.description: Issuing party's identifier for the finding.

finding_text_verbatim.description: The issuing party's wording, quoted exactly. Paraphrasing is the most common defect; this field captures the verbatim text as the audit trail.

finding_communication_date.description: Date the issuing party communicated the finding to the firm.

acceptance_rationale.description: Required when posture is 'partially-accept' or 'contest'; optional when 'accept'.

root_cause_named.description: Mechanism-anchored statement of why the finding occurred. Not a paraphrase of the finding.

consistency_with_issue_writeup.description: True where the response root cause matches the linked issue write-up's cause field. False surfaces as a reviewer question.

quantitative_estimate.description: Number with unit, or null where impact is qualitative.

basis.description: Pointer to the underlying source (loss-event log, capital-impact estimate, customer-impact tally).

dependency_ids.description: Other milestone IDs or external dependency identifiers. Empty array means 'no external dependencies' must be set true.

no_external_dependencies.description: Explicit assertion when no dependencies apply. Either dependency_ids is non-empty or this is true.

evidence_of_completion_expected.description: What evidence will demonstrate the milestone is completed. Distinct from evidence of effectiveness.

interim_mitigation.description: Steps already taken before the formal response date and any compensating controls in place pending full remediation.

evidence_period_post_remediation.description: e.g., 'two consecutive quarters at GREEN', 'two consecutive monthly readings at zero unreconciled items'.

evidence_owner.description: Role responsible for running the evidence-of-effectiveness check.

closure_trigger.description: Named condition under which the firm requests closure.

linked_issue_ids.description: Internal issue IDs this response covers or cross-references.

linked_finding_ids.description: Related findings sharing root cause or remediation actions.

prior_response_history.description: Where this response refreshes a prior response on the same finding ID, the slippage commentary is required.

approval_evidence.description: Pointer to committee minutes, named delegated-authority memo, or other approval artifact.

signed_by_role.description: Responding role. Higher-severity finding tiers carry a more senior firm-level signatory; the skill applies tier-specific defaults.

firm_level_signatory_role.description: Where applicable (commonly for the highest-severity supervisory tier): the firm-level signatory role (e.g., CEO, General Counsel).

confidence_label.description: Reflects executability of the action plan. 'high' requires named owners on every milestone, dependency-mapped milestones, and demonstrable interim mitigation.

reviewer_questions.description: Questions the responding role expects from the issuing party in follow-up.
